summary: Python 3.6 added f-strings (formatted string literals), async generators and comprehensions, variable annotations (PEP 526), and secrets module. Dictionaries became insertion-ordered (implementation detail, later guaranteed in 3.7). Underscores in numeric literals (1_000_000) improved readability. The 3.6 branch received five years of support.
notes: Unsupported since 2021-12-23. Last micro 3.6.15. Full support ended 2018-12-24. f-strings rapidly became the preferred string formatting method.
